content:
incident-bot: 🔔 High error rate detected: Hosted inference gateway (us-east-2a) 502/504 spike starting 1718456700. 5m error rate 5.8%, latency p95-> 1.9s.
monitor-bot: Top symptoms: repeated upstream resets, elevated tcp retransmits (0.9-1.6%), auth latency increased.
dan-oncall: I'm on it. Initial checks: no deploys in last 2 hours. Rolling retries observed.
carla-support: Customer-facing: multiple customers reported timeouts and broken responses for generation requests ~ 11:07–11:45. Customers affected: acme-inc, quickforms, studybot. CS requested ETA.
alice-sre: Grabbed trtcp/sniffer from one affected host. Saw bursts of duplicate ACKs and retransmits to provider edge. tcpdump excerpt: 
```
11:11:02 IP a.b.c.d.443 > x.y.z.12345: Flags [P.], seq 1234:2345, ack 987, win 4096, length 1111
11:11:02 IP x.y.z.12345 > a.b.c.d.443: Flags [R], seq 0, ack 0, win 0, length 0
... repeated dup acks, fast retransmit
```

ben-network: Looking at provider telemetry for us-east-2a. We see ECMP imbalance to carrier-3 -> one path showing >1% loss and microbursts around 11:05-11:40. BGP show neighbor 203.0.113.17 flapping (prefix withdraw/announce).

ben-network: Also seeing interface queue drops on our edge facing provider-3 during the spike (device x-rt-12). Provider acknowledged degraded uplink and says they're investigating.

carla-support: Any temporary mitigations we can tell customers? Some want immediate failover.

alice-sre: We can DR traffic away from us-east-2a to us-east-2b and us-east-1 region for hosted API; spinning up routing rule to prefer healthy AZs. Initiating canary reroute for non-SLA customers now.
dan-oncall: Doing weighted routing change: 0% -> us-east-2a for test tenant pool, pushing to all non-enterprise. Rolling now.
erin-cs: Noted enterprise tenants (enterprise-ids list) must be contacted before failover. Will message account owners ASAP.
frank-product: Prod impact note: some short-lived auth errors were observed (upstream auth timeouts returned 502 to clients). Need to audit billing/usage counters for duplicated retries.

alice-sre: Confirmed reduced error rate after routing change: 5m error rate dropped to 0.6% in 3 mins. Latency p95 improved.

ben-network: Provider says they're scheduling fiber carrier handoff; ETA 45m. We'll keep traffic diverted until provider confirms stable ECMP.

carla-support: Logged incident to support portal, sent advisory to affected customers with recommended retries/backoff and expected timeline.

frank-product: Can SRE capture a small reproducible curl sample for CS to include in customer notes? Something like:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \ 
  -d '{"input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
```
Add suggestion: enforce client-side 5xx retry with exponential backoff and de-dupe idempotency token.

alice-sre: Saved packet captures and BGP logs to /var/tmp/incidents/1718456789-pcap.tar.gz. Will attach to provider ticket.
dan-oncall: Followups: 1) Keep routing diversion until provider confirms; 2) run post-mortem once provider updates; 3) validate billing for duplicate tokens. Assigning owners: ben-network (provider comms), alice-sre (evidence and rollback), carla-support (customer comms), erin-cs (enterprise notifications), frank-product (billing audit).

monitor-bot: FYI alert escalation created: INC-2026-4592. Slack thread pinned to incident.

erin-cs: Sent targeted messages to enterprise account owners and scheduled a check-in 30m after confirmation.

carla-support: Customers acked workaround and appreciate proactive reroute. Closing customer-facing loop.

ben-network: Provider update: handoff completed at 1718461000, observed stable ECMP, loss <0.05% for 10m. Will coordinate final verification tomorrow morning.

alice-sre: Marking incident as mitigated at 1718461100; monitoring for recurrence. Postmortem requested, capturing timeline + recommended automatic failover for AZ-level provider degradation.

frank-product: Noted: add automated post-failover billing reconciliation to prevent double-charges from client retries.

incident-bot: Incident status -> MITIGATED (routing diversion). Next: postmortem due by EOD + owner assignments recorded.

carla-support: Closing thread for now. Re-open if errors reappear. :white_check_mark:
